description: Default demo scenario. Events are injected into the simulated factory so the briefing has something real to discover. The briefing code never reads this file; it has to find these events from the data alone, which also makes this file the ground truth for measuring discovery recall.

events.note: Continuation of the late-March assembly dip already visible in the original data
Dryer breakdown in the washing room
All TrendCart orders stop moving (trim supplier delay)
Order goes quiet while waiting for a yarn colour approval
Large rush order lands with a short lead time
